project_name: SIPOSTLOG - Sistem Informasi Pemantauan Stock Opname Logistik BPBD Kabupaten Banjar
target_audience: Masyarakat Kabupaten Banjar (Public View) & Petugas Logistik BPBD (Internal App)

features: Summary counters: Total Items (33), Count of 'Aman', Count of 'Menipis'
Category filter tabs (Semua, Pangan, Sandang, Shelter/Hunian, Sanitasi, Evakuasi)
Timestamp of last stock opname update
Header with 'Masuk Petugas' button trigger modal

sidebar_navigation.label: Dashboard Stok
sidebar_navigation.description: Ringkasan stok riil 33 barang logistik, grafik kategori, dan alert stok menipis

sidebar_navigation.label: Dashboard Penyaluran
sidebar_navigation.description: Grafik tren distribusi harian, total penyaluran per posko/kecamatan & jenis bencana (HANYA DI MENU INTERNAL)

sidebar_navigation.label: Catat Barang Masuk
sidebar_navigation.description: Formulir penerimaan pasokan logistik baru dari BNPB/Hibah/APBD

sidebar_navigation.label: Catat Penyaluran
sidebar_navigation.description: Formulir distribusi logistik ke posko lapangan / daerah terdampak

sidebar_navigation.label: Stock Opname / Koreksi
sidebar_navigation.description: Formulir penyesuaian jumlah stok fisik beserta alasan audit

sidebar_navigation.label: Riwayat Transaksi
sidebar_navigation.description: Tabel audit trail mutasi stok (Masuk, Penyaluran, Koreksi) immutable

sidebar_navigation.label: Ekspor & Import Excel
sidebar_navigation.description: Unduh laporan Excel dan upload berkas Excel untuk update stock opname massal

sidebar_navigation.label: Kelola Pengguna
sidebar_navigation.description: Manajemen peran petugas & persetujuan akun baru (Admin Only)

layout_and_bento.card_style: rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 bg-slate-800/80 backdrop-blur-md p-6 shadow-xl hover:border-amber-500/40 transition-all duration-200
layout_and_bento.stat_cards: Flat background with accent left border (Green for Aman, Amber/Red for Alert, Blue for Activity)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL 33 logistics items from src/data/initialData.ts are accurately tracked and preserved.
Do NOT sum quantities across different measurement units (e.g. KG, DOS, BUAH, METER).
Strictly enforce that public users CANNOT see item quantity counts — only 'Aman' or 'Menipis' status badges.
Add Dashboard Penyaluran module exclusively within the internal authenticated web app menu.
Implement Excel Import/Export capability allowing batch stock updates from spreadsheet files.
Remove all AI references, AI bot widgets, or AI markers from UI.
Ensure responsive layout, accessible contrast, smooth transitions, and data-testid attributes on key components.
